overall_comments: Round 2 retrofit clears the strict bar. All four required injections land cleanly: (1) Behr, Erlwanger & Nichols (1980) and Carpenter, Franke & Levi (2003) cited in expanded_walkthrough.rationale and again in action step 6 anchoring the relational view of equality; (2) Day-1 callback opens minds_on ('Yesterday Detective Dee opened the VARIABLE BOXES (Day 1). Today the unknown number lives INSIDE an addition equation') and is reinforced in expanded_walkthrough; (3) Detective Dee's signature 'Find it! Then CHECK it! That's the Detective way!' is the hook opener and the exit_routine chant — a distinctive quotable refrain that exceeds Level 4 voice; (4) STRATEGY COMPARE in action step 6 has pairs share their own strategy across count-up, count-back, known-fact, and balance, then the class compares efficiency for 5+?=12 vs 20+?=50, which is exactly the strategy-invent-and-compare move that earns Level 4 mathematical_authenticity. Equal-sign-as-operator misconception is the named trap with branched DIAGNOSTIC A/B/C recovery moves. Puppets are explicitly OPTIONAL and the floor-number-line movement variant gives a no-paper alternative. Worksheet Parts 1/2 mirror the lesson at 50 and 100 ranges; Part 3 (make your own case) is a justified transfer task. Cleared for advancement.
